info.name: Uniblock Direct Direct Pass-Through Transactions API

params.name: chain
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., ethereum, polygon, solana, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, base).

params.name: address
params.description: The wallet address to query data for.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of transactions associated with a specific wallet address, including both incoming and outgoing transactions across the specified blockchain network.

params.name: chain
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., ethereum, polygon, solana, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, base).

params.name: transactionHash
params.description: The hash of the transaction to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific transaction by its transaction hash, including status, gas used, block number, and input data.
